scope: UKS existing-g2 cross-owner adjacency reuse only
reuse_candidates: all existing primary and replica groups
selection: ascending group ID; consume earliest still-unused raw occurrences of both distinct members; at most one reference to a given group per owner
retained_unit_order: original units with consumed raw occurrences removed, then newly added group IDs in ascending order
validation: exact per-owner expanded CSC neighbor multiset; original groups retained; no new raw edges; empty supernode rows
sampler: unchanged UKS incremental group-aware outer sampler
storage_annotation: unchanged per-logical-node minimum selected group row
comparison: old DiGiT versus reuse DiGiT, same frozen BFS roots, Freq hot set, CPU/GPU capacities, seed, model, fanouts and optimizer
diagnostic: separate untimed 300-batch audit of group edge occurrences, physical pairs, mapping losses, CPU eligibility and native pair counts
graph_host_storage: anonymous CSC copies before CUDA registration for both controls
